titolo: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings beta for Google Meet
descr: Claude Meetings lets Anthropic's Claude join Google Meet calls, answer questions, create docs and whiteboards, and log notes.
paragrafi: Anthropic announced Claude Meetings, a beta feature that adds Claude as a visible participant in video calls.
During a meeting Claude can answer spoken or typed queries, generate documents, whiteboards and other artifacts, and record notes and action items.
The service currently supports only Google Meet and is available to Team and Enterprise plan customers; other platforms are promised later.
Privacy defaults keep Claude out of calls with external participants, though admins can override this setting.
Organizations with HIPAA, zero‑data‑retention, or customer‑managed encryption configurations cannot use the feature during the beta.
All meeting artifacts, including transcripts and generated files, are stored on a dedicated page in claude.ai after the call.
perche: For AI users, Claude Meetings offers a hands‑free assistant that can capture minutes and produce collaborative content in real time, reducing manual note‑taking. Free‑model enthusiasts may see this as a reminder that advanced AI assistance often resides behind paid enterprise plans, reinforcing the value of exploring open‑source alternatives for similar workflow automation.
